# Rowan corrects the moving and table dates

Wholly fictional test material. This is Rowan’s exact new statement on 2026-11-06. The calendar wording is quoted inside Rowan’s statement; the calendar itself has not been independently inspected. It is not a replacement for the unchanged original interview or imported posts.

## Correction

Speaker: Rowan

That August date was my mistake. I found my calendar entry: ‘7 September 2019 — moved into the room over the bakery, Kit brought the books.’ Please correct my rabbit hole. Also, the line in the January post was just shortened: I returned the table to Kit on 19 December 2019, and Kit took it back to their aunt. I remember the date because it was the day before my train trip.

## Editorial scope

The corrected move date is 7 September 2019, attributed to Rowan’s explicit correction and reported calendar entry. The table passed from Rowan to Kit on 19 December 2019. Kit then took it back to their aunt; the date of that onward handover is not separately supplied. The train-trip reference explains Rowan’s dating recollection; it does not establish an itinerary.
